children.text: Local power, public records

Section 1: Citizens deserve a clear record of public decisions. The Dispatch follows council agendas, interviews neighborhood organizers and checks budget claims against primary documents. Civicledger reporting connects these records with the people affected by each decision. Readers can reproduce our findings and send corrections to the editorial board.
